## Section 6: Drift Risks (Merged)

### From Citation Expansion (03b)
1. **PDF text extraction unavailable** — References extracted via known literature connections + arxiv_search title queries rather than direct PDF parsing. All 41 resolved IDs cross-verified.
2. **21 references remain unresolved** — Self-defined benchmarks (LitQA, ScholarQABench), evaluation methodologies, conference-only publications without arXiv IDs.
3. **No pre-2000 cocitation theory** — Acceptable because the survey automation subfield is post-2020; the deepest backward expansion reaches 2016 (GCN).
4. **Forward expansion is partial** — arxiv_search title matching finds only papers that explicitly cite a seed in title/abstract; additional citing papers may exist.

### From Semantic Expansion (03c)
5. **KV cache query (Q1) produced 100% drift** — All 10 results were LLM inference optimization papers. This is a clean boundary probe: the gap between KV optimization and survey generation remains unfilled because the two communities are disjunct.
6. **High overlap on multi-agent query (Q5)** — 7/10 results already in pool, confirming the pool's comprehensive coverage of multi-agent survey systems but showing diminishing returns for this query family.
7. **Citation recommendation bleed (Q2)** — 6 citation recommendation papers surfaced, all excluded per scope_exclude. Future expansions targeting citation graph traversal should add explicit exclusion terms.

### Overarching Risks
8. **run_dir recovered as `"."`** — No upstream run_dir was passed in context; all artifacts written to the current working directory.
9. **All expansions are 2020–2026** — No pre-2020 papers surfaced from semantic expansion; backward expansion from seeds is the sole path to older foundational work.
10. **No cross-community bridging** — The gap between citation graph structure methods (GCN, SPECTER) and survey generation remains largely unbridged; only SurveyG and LitFM explicitly combine both.

## Section 7: Remaining Gaps & Next Expansion Directions

### Gaps identified but not filled

| Gap | Reason | Potential fill path |
|-----|--------|-------------------|
| **Pre-2020 cocitation theory** | Beyond arXiv scope (1973–2002 journal literature) | Dedicated backward expansion via Semantic Scholar API |
| **Knowledge-graph-based survey methods** | ORKG-driven work already in pool; no new additions | Targeted query with "ORKG" or "knowledge graph survey" |
| **Human evaluation protocols** | Not captured by citation or semantic queries | Dedicated query on "human evaluation protocol survey generation" |
| **RL-based citation traversal** | No papers combine RL explicitly with citation traversal for surveys | Future query: "reinforcement learning for citation path discovery" |
| **Closed-source evaluations** | Commercial systems (OpenAI Deep Research, Google Scholar LM) | Manual addition when reports are published |

### Recommended queries for next expansion cycle

1. `"citation graph snowballing methodology OR literature review systematic mapping survey automation"` — to capture backward from SurveyG/LitFM into snowballing/cocitation literature
2. `"knowledge graph survey generation OR KG-guided literature review"` — to explore the ORKG / knowledge graph dimension
3. `"human evaluation protocol survey generation OR quality rubric academic survey"` — to fill the human evaluation gap
4. `"reinforcement learning citation graph pathfinding papers discovery"` — to probe the RL-for-citation-traversal gap
5. `"closed loop survey generation iterative refinement self-citation"` — to capture emerging closed-loop systems
